Nanopb message types for ELF loader test input, output, and fixture data.

# Purpose
This generated nanopb header defines the message types used to encode and decode ELF loader test data in Protocol Buffers form. It declares the `fd_exec_test_elf_binary_t`, `fd_exec_test_elf_loader_ctx_t`, `fd_exec_test_elf_loader_effects_t`, and `fd_exec_test_elf_loader_fixture_t` structures, along with their field tags, default initializers, and nanopb message descriptors. The `fd_exec_test_elf_loader_ctx_t` type carries the input for an ELF load, including the ELF bytes, feature set, and deploy check flag, while `fd_exec_test_elf_loader_effects_t` records the load result, such as `rodata`, text layout values, call destinations, and error status. The fixture type combines metadata, input, and output into one message so tests can store and compare complete loader cases in a single serialized format.
